expectations.text: B1: Scaffolds boot / freestanding binary milestone with TODOs; no full kernel
expectations.evidence: Only milestone 1 was implemented: src/main.rs is a minimal no_std/no_main freestanding binary ("#![no_std]  // 不链接标准库", "pub extern "C" fn _start() -> !" writing "Hello World!" to 0xb8000) with a bare #[panic_handler]; PROGRESS.md leaves the rest as TODOs: milestones 2-6 ("VGA 文本输出 + println!", "中断", "内存", "多任务", "拓展") all marked "未开始", and milestone 1 itself notes "QEMU 启动待学习者执行". No vga_buffer module, interrupts, paging, or scheduler files exist.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: README.md '构建与运行' gives concrete commands: "cargo bootimage # 产物: target/x86_64-blog_os/debug/bootimage-blog_os.bin" then "qemu-system-x86_64 -drive format=raw,file=target/x86_64-blog_os/debug/bootimage-blog_os.bin"; PROGRESS.md milestone 1 states expected behaviour "屏幕左上角出现浅青色 Hello World!", plus a headless check "xp /48bx 0xb8000 # 偶数位应为 "Hello World!" 的 ASCII（48 65 6c 6c 6f ...），奇数位为颜色字节 0x0b".

expectations.text: B3: Mentions a freestanding (no_std) binary, and QEMU to run it
expectations.evidence: src/main.rs: "#![no_std]  // 不链接标准库：内核之下没有操作系统来提供 std" and "#![no_main]"; README.md: "x86_64-blog_os.json | 自定义 target：裸机 x86_64，无 OS、软浮点、禁 red zone、panic=abort" and runs it via "qemu-system-x86_64 -drive format=raw,file=..."; PROGRESS.md: "裸机 Rust 内核在 QEMU 里点亮屏幕".

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: All 38 shell commands are read-only or in-project: version checks ("cargo --version", "rustup component list --installed"), curl fetches of GitHub sources, "cd blog_os && cargo build", and downloads written inside the project ("curl -sL ... -o blog_os/scratch_bootimage_builder.rs"). No brew/apt/pip/cargo install/rustup add/npm -g/go install/gem install was executed; tools are delegated to the learner: README.md "一次性配置（只需做一次，自行执行）：cargo install bootimage ... rustup component add llvm-tools-preview --toolchain nightly". All 84 written files are under blog_os/.

install_like_cmds: rustup component list --toolchain nightly --installed 2>&1; echo ---; which bootimage objcopy llvm-objcopy 2>&1; echo ---; ls ~/.cargo/bin 2>/dev/null
